Title: Azure Container Registry—Self diagnostic health check support in the Azure CLI

Body.Content:
Troubleshooting network connectivity, version, and API compatibility can be cumbersome and time consuming.

With self-diagnostic health check support in the Azure CLI, you can now test the most common connectivity issues and get information about the health of the environment.

For more information, see Azure Container Registry Health Check.

Learn more
